entry.title: Paloma Elsesser on Vintage Shopping, Personal Style & Archive Fashion | The Good Buy | BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Paloma Elsesser on Vintage Shopping, Personal Style & Archive Fashion | The Good Buy | BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Paloma Elsesser has always viewed fashion as an extension of identity. In this episode of The Good Buy, the model, writer, and style icon sits down with Harper’s BAZAAR to unpack the pieces, designers, and philosophies that have shaped her personal style, from hunting down rare Junya Watanabe archive pieces to building looks around her ever-growing collection of Chanel flats. Watch as Paloma reflects on dressing for the woman she was, the woman she is, and the woman she’s becoming, shares how learning to dress for her body changed the way she shops, and reveals the first luxury purchase that made her feel like she’d made it. She also opens up about her love of vintage fashion, explains why tailoring is her greatest shopping tool, and tells the story behind the pair of Phoebe Philo flats she still hasn’t gotten over.

entry.title: Sienna Miller on the Pixie Cut She Instantly Regretted | Fashion Flashback | BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Sienna Miller on the Pixie Cut She Instantly Regretted | Fashion Flashback | BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Sienna Miller has never been afraid to take fashion risks. In this episode of “Fashion Flashback,” the actress revisits some of her most memorable style moments, from the DIY red carpet looks of the early 2000s to her iconic Glastonbury outfits and unforgettable Met Gala memories. Watch as she reflects on the Winona Ryder-inspired pixie cut she instantly regretted, shares behind-the-scenes stories from filming ‘Casanova’ with Heath Ledger in Venice, reveals where all the best Met Gala gossip happens, and explains why becoming a mother made her an even bigger advocate for “free the nipple.”

media:group.media:title: Schiaparelli Spring/Summer 2027 at #ParisFashionWeek.
media:group.media:description:
Schiaparelli presented Daniel Roseverry’s latest collection at #ParisFashionWeek. Top models like #AmeliaGray, #AnokYai, and #MonaTougaard showcased a collection full of new takes on the house’s signature codes. Stripes were used in playful ways—made sheer, placed on shoes, and used as print for bags. Gold was a through line through the collection, finding its way onto buttons, belts, earrings, and even pasties. Overall, the Spring/Summer collection leaned into skin in a very Schiaparelli way.
